description: Defines functions related to UCI (Uplink Control Information) message processing in 5G NR, including calculation of codeblocks, CRC bits, and minimum encoded bits for UCI messages.

methods.name: get_nof_uci_codeblocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of codeblocks for a UCI message based on message and codeword lengths.

methods.name: get_uci_crc_size
methods.description: Determines the number of CRC bits per UCI codeblock based on payload size.

methods.name: get_uci_nof_crc_bits
methods.description: Calculates total CRC bits for a UCI message considering segmentation.

methods.name: calculate_uci_min_encoded_bits
methods.description: Computes the minimum number of rate-matched bits required for correct decoding of a UCI payload.
